Install a WildObsR Skill for Claude

Source: R/install_claude_skill.R
install_claude_skill.Rd

Copies a Claude skill that ships with WildObsR into your Claude skills folder, so Claude (for example Claude Code) understands WildObs data when you work with it.

Usage

install_claude_skill(
  skill = "wildobsr-data",
  dest = "~/.claude/skills",
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

skill

Character string. The skill to install. Defaults to "wildobsr-data", currently the only skill bundled with WildObsR.

dest

Character string. The folder that holds your Claude skills. Defaults to "~/.claude/skills".

overwrite

Logical. Replace the skill if it is already installed in dest. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

The path to the installed skill folder, invisibly. Stops if skill is not bundled with WildObsR, if it is already installed and overwrite = FALSE, or if the copy fails.

Details

A skill is a folder of plain-text instructions that Claude reads when a task needs it. The wildobsr-data skill explains how WildObs data packages are structured: how the tables join, what each field means, which analyses the data can support, and the WildObs additions to Camtrap DP. It contains documentation only, no code.

The skill's counts of projects and records describe the public database on the date given in the skill, so treat them as approximate. They drift between releases as projects are added and as embargoes are set, extended or released, which moves projects between open and partial. The skill tells Claude to check each project's sharing preference when it runs, rather than relying on those counts.

The function works as follows:

  1. It checks that skill is one of the skills bundled with this version of WildObsR.

  2. If that skill is already installed in dest, it stops unless overwrite = TRUE, so a copy you have edited is never replaced silently.

  3. It copies the skill folder into dest, creating dest if needed.

The default dest, ~/.claude/skills, makes the skill available to Claude Code in every project. To limit it to one project, point dest at that project's .claude/skills folder. Re-run with overwrite = TRUE after updating WildObsR to get the skill that matches the new version.

Author

Zachary Amir & Claude Opus 5.5

Examples

# Install into a temporary folder to see what gets copied
path <- install_claude_skill(dest = tempdir())
#> Installed the wildobsr-data skill to /tmp/RtmpP69ga0/wildobsr-data
#> Start a new Claude Code session for Claude to pick it up.
list.files(path, recursive = TRUE)
#> [1] "SKILL.md"              "reference/metadata.md" "reference/tables.md"  

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Install for Claude Code in every project
install_claude_skill()

# After updating WildObsR, refresh the installed copy
install_claude_skill(overwrite = TRUE)
} # }
